# LuaSPortSensor:idle

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Set / unset the S.Port Sensor IDLE mode.

```lua
local result = sensor:idle([state])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | boolean | optional (default `true`) |  |

## Returns

result (boolean)
